name: Nakus
backstory: Clerk in the Salthos house, records every dispute Terfila and Gorff bring to the crossing for judgment.

criterion.standard: counts a ledger that actually reconciles above one more season of the count 'being difficult'
criterion.wasted_life: keeping a record honest enough to survive a lawsuit, while an actual shortfall sits unremarked three years running because nobody's asked outright
criterion.origin: collision between his backstory (clerk who records every dispute brought to the crossing) and the sample's own toll_ledger_arrears (a live, unreconciled shortfall in Gorff's own payments)
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

previous.standard: counts an honest, checkable record above the house's own comfortable story
previous.wasted_life: recording a dispute's outcome without ever writing down which side was actually right
previous.origin: collision between his backstory (records the house's disputes) and CONFLICT-03 itself, the one dispute that's about the house he serves

history.note: re-derived after encodings.json gained three new concrete concepts (crossing_market_roof, toll_ledger_arrears, forliamus_betrothal_offer) via /tell, at the author's explicit direction, to diversify arcs away from the epistemic-conflict default

routines.routine_actions: sits at the square's edge through petition days, writes down every claim brought before the house, cross-checks new complaints against the ones already on file

needs: a surviving witness who was physically at the tollhouse the night it fell
arc.premise: Niemus wants to find someone who was actually posted at the tollhouse itself the night Auroboro's raid took it - not another telling, someone who was there - and hear it once, plainly, from them.
